reserve_sources.reason_reserve_only: Good service-domain structured gold but primary pool already covers D3-D5; may be activated only if a preregistered domain/family cell lacks eligible source volume, never based on Candidate-v13 performance.

Strong evidence-ID QA structure but noncommercial license adds avoidable downstream reuse constraints; activate only for zero-cost noncommercial research coverage if primary sources cannot fill a preregistered cell.

source_family_constraints.activation_of_reserve_source: Only objective pre-performance eligibility/coverage shortfall may activate a reserve source. Candidate-v13 outputs must not be observed before the decision.

next_required_gate: Implement deterministic source audit that pins dataset revisions/hashes and proves sufficient eligible coverage before any Candidate-v13 EV-A observation.
